annotations.title: Show a hidden Home card again

description: Put a hidden getting-started card back on Home (see hidden_cards in today_summary) and reset it, so a later Hide snoozes it for a week again. Use when the person asks to see it again, or agrees when a hidden step blocks what they asked for (say which).

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: home_show
